headline: Can AI Help Scientists Read the Moon?
quick_start: NASA and IBM released an open-source AI model for lunar science. It can help researchers map craters, study volcanic features, and estimate places where ice may be stable near the Moon's poles.

sources.title: NASA, IBM Launch AI Foundation Model for Lunar Science
IBM and NASA Release Open-Source AI Model to Support Lunar Exploration
IBM, NASA launch AI model to help map ice, craters on Moon

focus_sentence: Because the model is already trained on lunar data, scientists can adapt it to map craters and estimate where ice may be stable.
